label: Investment banking — MBA summer associate cycle
audience: First-year MBA recruiting for a summer associate seat (US calendar; bulge bracket, elite boutique and middle market)
disclaimer: A curated template of a typical US MBA associate calendar, not live firm deadlines. Banking dates move earlier almost every year and vary by bank, group and region — several banks now run accelerated processes weeks ahead of this. Confirm every date with your finance club and each bank's campus team, then edit this file: a copy in your data dir at timelines/investment_banking.json overrides the bundled one.

milestones.name: Pre-MBA diversity and early insight programs
milestones.description: Banks run fellowship and early-insight programs in the spring and summer BEFORE your first year. Several convert directly into summer associate offers, which is the single biggest head start in banking.
actions: Apply the spring before you matriculate — most deadlines are April to June
Track each program as an application with its real deadline
Reach out to the campus recruiter for every bank you apply to

milestones.name: Pre-term and technical foundations
milestones.description: Banking assumes you can already talk accounting and valuation. Non-finance backgrounds need this summer, not October.
actions: Pick 10-15 banks across bulge bracket, elite boutique and middle market
Work through the three statements, DCF, comps and LBO basics before term starts
Join the finance club and submit to the resume book
Import your LinkedIn connections so warm paths exist before the first event

milestones.name: Bank presentations and campus events
milestones.description: Banks track attendance and pass names to the deal teams. Being a known quantity before applications is most of the game.
actions: Attend every target bank's presentation and coffee-chat session
Collect the names of bankers and campus recruiters you actually spoke to
Log each conversation the same night and send a thank-you within 24 hours

milestones.name: Banker networking campaign
milestones.description: The most networking-dependent track there is. Aim for coverage across groups, not just headcount — a champion in the group you want matters more than ten scattered chats.
actions: 2-4 bankers per target bank, weighted toward the groups you want
Alumni first: use find_alumni to build the LinkedIn searches
Ask about deals and group culture, never about the process
Set a next_followup date on every interaction — bankers forget fast

milestones.name: Applications and resume drops
milestones.description: Most MBA associate applications close between early October and mid-November, and accelerated processes close sooner.
actions: Track every application with its real deadline
Tailor the CV per bank; deal exposure and quantitative evidence up top
Have a banker flag your resume internally before you submit
Prepare 'why banking, why this bank, why this group' in three sentences

milestones.name: First rounds and HireVue
milestones.description: Behavioral plus technical, often recorded. Technicals are pass/fail — they are the floor, not the differentiator.
actions: Drill the standard technical set until answers are automatic
Record yourself once; the video format punishes rambling
Refresh your notes on everyone you met at the bank

milestones.name: Superdays and offers
milestones.description: Back-to-back interviews with the group, decided same-day at many banks. Offers often come with short exploding deadlines.
actions: Prepare a crisp deal or market view you can defend
Thank-you notes to every interviewer within 24 hours
Log offer deadlines as application deadlines the moment you get one

milestones.name: Offer decisions and sell days
milestones.description: Exploding offers are common. Ask for extensions early and in writing.
actions: Attend sell days only for banks you would genuinely accept
Ask for a timing extension the day you need it, not the week it expires
Tell the bankers who backed you either way — they remember

milestones.name: Middle market, boutique and off-cycle wave
milestones.description: Middle-market banks, regional offices and boutiques hire well after the on-campus cycle, almost entirely through networks.
actions: Add middle-market and regional banks as new targets
Run find_jobs weekly on the boards you have already resolved
Reactivate dormant contacts with get_followups
